Right to fair hearing

______ may be defined as a section of the government charged with the principal duties of implementing government policies and decisions.
Public Service
Public Service may be defined as a section of the government charged with the principal duties of implementing government policies and decisions.
______ is the Chief Executive Officer of the state where he presides.
absolute monarch
An absolute monarch is the Chief Executive Officer of the state where he presides.
______ is the responsibility of the entire cabinet, first to the parliament and ultimately to the people, for the policies and conduct of the executive arm of government during their term of office.
Ministerial responsibility

Ministerial responsibility is the responsibility of the entire cabinet, first to the parliament and ultimately to the people, for the policies and conduct of the executive arm of government during their term of office.
______ is an administrative body which has the force of law and which is set up to investigate and adjudicate in disputes referred to it.
tribunal
A tribunal is an administrative body which has the force of law and which is set up to investigate and adjudicate in disputes referred to it.
______ is a radical and fundamental tenet of the rule of law and the cornerstone of democracy.
allegation of crime
allegation of crime is a radical and fundamental tenet of the rule of law and the cornerstone of democracy.
______ means an administration that is powered by local government people, charged with the responsibility of conducting business for the local communities in the designated area.
local government administration

Meaning The local government administration means an administration that is powered by local government people, charged with the responsibility of conducting business for the local communities in the designated area.
______ is a process of organizing and executing functions effectively and efficiently in order to achieve the objectives of a nation.
Public Administration
Public Administration is a process of organizing and executing functions effectively and efficiently in order to achieve the objectives of a nation.
______ means that a country is governed by civil law or regular law, that is, laws which are reasonably justifiable in a democratic society, as opposed to draconian, oppressive and arbitrary laws.
Rule of law

Rule of law means that a country is governed by civil law or regular law, that is, laws which are reasonably justifiable in a democratic society, as opposed to draconian, oppressive and arbitrary laws.
______ means every branch, arm, department, authority, agency, or institution of government and the people who work for them.
civil service
The civil service means every branch, arm, department, authority, agency, or institution of government and the people who work for them.
______ is a writ for securing the liberty or immediate release of a person from unlawful custody or other unjustifiable detention.
habeas corpus
A habeas corpus is a writ for securing the liberty or immediate release of a person from unlawful custody or other unjustifiable detention.
